verdict.rationale: Apple's only gaming claim is qualitative: the improved hardware-accelerated ray-tracing GPU makes "games like Control look more compelling," and Metal exposes the GPU to developers. The pack has no frame-rate figures and no independent game benchmarks; the one community gaming item is just an open question about competing with RTX cards, not corroboration or contradiction. missing for 10: actual frame-rate numbers in real games, independent or hands-on game benchmarks, vendor detail on cache and boost behavior, GPU class comparisons against discrete gaming GPUs.
